name: zcode-ops
description: Inspect, select models for, and control existing ZCode desktop tasks through the official remote workspace bridge.

interface.shortDescription: Read and send to existing ZCode desktop tasks.
interface.longDescription: ZCode Ops reads real desktop task status, conversation snapshots, and model options, switches idle tasks to an advertised model, then sends user-authorized prompts through ZCode's remote workspace bridge. Legacy ACP creation remains suspended. The transport is intentionally narrow and can later support other desktop intelligent agents through compatible adapters.
